note: First-floor clock room, behind the great tower clock face. Feminine nouns on the left (la matinée, l'horloge, la reprise, l'alerte, la pendule, la session), the adjective matinal in the middle, masculine on the right (le délai, le crépuscule, le millénaire, l'intérim, le retardataire). The stairs on the far left go DOWN to the adverbs hall; the wooden door on the right leads to the second adverbs room.
